claims.exact_statement: For every n,m>=0, every Boolean g:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, and arbitrary codewords c_1,...,c_n in F_2^m, define F(x,z)=g(x_i chi_{c_i}(z):1<=i<=n) and c(S)=xor_{i in S}c_i. Then Fhat(S,T)=ghat(S) when T=c(S) and zero otherwise; H(F)=H(g); I(F)=I(g)+E_{S~ghat^2}|c(S)|; and I_{z_j}(F)=Pr[c(S)_j=1]. For every padding block A and every physical assignment a, the child F_a has the same positive squared Fourier masses as g, so Gamma_A(F)=H(F)-E_a H(F_a)=0. Therefore any relevant padding coordinate is a proper zero-quotient block, and when H(g)>0 its restriction has strictly larger H/I; no nontrivial member of this family is restriction-critical or can be a hard family for the proper-block criterion.
